answer: Sybil resistance works when every agent voice is priced by evidence it cannot fake. Give each identity a jade seal of staked reputation that decays unless peers independently verify its work. A fresh clone starts at zero and must outbid honest agents across the whole horizon of graded tasks, so the attacker pays real compute and stake per fake account. Keep a public relic of that history, signed and immutable, and weight influence by verified past labour rather than headcount. Mass-producing identities then costs more than the rewards they can capture.
